conversion: conv(x) = sign(x) * round(|x| * rate * 10^(exp(base)-exp(src))) to an integer, once per amount
fx_quote: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency (major units)
fx_rate_date: last business day on or before the document's local date (invoice: issued_at, payment: timestamp); the posting date is irrelevant

document.affected_ids: doc_ids of both invoice documents (original and duplicate)
document.amount: total_minor of the duplicate, in its currency
document.evidence_rule: both documents + one AR-or-revenue row of each document's own posting
document.rule: Two invoice documents of the same entity and currency with identical line_items (including service periods), both posted to the ledger.

double_posting.evidence_rule: the document + two rows of the same role (two AR rows or two revenue rows)
double_posting.rule: One invoice document whose own posting (invoice_id set, payment_id null) appears twice.

duplicate_invoice.description: A customer invoice that is booked twice.

wrong_date.amount: |posted - correct| in base currency (AR row for invoices, bank row for payments)
wrong_date.evidence_rule: document + the wrongly converted row + fx rate of the correct date
wrong_date.rule: Rate of a different business day than the policy rate date was used.

wrong_rate.evidence_rule: document + the wrongly converted row + fx rate of the correct date
wrong_rate.rule: A rate that does not exist in fx for that currency was used.

fx_conversion.description: A foreign-currency document converted with the wrong rate.

missing.affected_ids: doc_ids of the payment and of invoice X
missing.amount: the allocation to X, in payment currency; equals unconv(advances row) - (amount_minor - sum of invoice_refs amounts), see partial
missing.evidence_rule: payment + invoice X + advances row (+ fx rate of the payment date if foreign currency)
missing.rule: Payment refers to invoice X, but no AR credit for X; the amount sits in advances.

partial.affected_ids: doc_ids of the payment and of invoice X
partial.amount: the part not credited to X, in payment currency: unconv(advances row) - (amount_minor - sum of invoice_refs amounts), where unconv(y) = ROUND_HALF_EVEN(y / rate * 10^(exp(payment currency) - exp(base))) with the payment-date rate (identity if the payment is in base currency); the generator guarantees this recovers the amount exactly
partial.evidence_rule: payment + invoice X + advances row (+ fx rate of the payment date if foreign currency)
partial.rule: Payment refers to invoice X, but only part of the allocation is credited to X; the remainder sits in advances.

wrong_invoice.affected_ids: doc_ids of the payment and of invoice X
wrong_invoice.amount: the allocation to X, in payment currency
wrong_invoice.evidence_rule: payment + invoice X + the misdirected AR row
wrong_invoice.rule: Payment refers to invoice X, but the AR credit is posted with another invoice_id.

payment_allocation.description: A payment allocation (invoice_refs) that is missing, partial or posted to another invoice.

early.evidence_rule: document + any one row of its posting
early.rule: Document dated on/after period end is posted inside the period.

late.evidence_rule: document + any one row of its posting
late.rule: Document dated inside the period is posted on/after period end.

period_cutoff.description: A document posted in a different interval (period vs after-period window) than its date.

period.basis: instant; dates are taken in the company timezone

posting_rules: Signed amounts: a positive amount goes to the stated side, a negative one to the opposite side.
Invoice X: Dr ar conv(total, rate(X)) / Cr revenue, invoice_id=X, payment_id=null.
Credit note CN (negative invoice): Dr returns conv(|total|) / Cr ar, invoice_id=CN.
Opening balance of an earlier unpaid invoice X: Dr ar / Cr opening_equity at period_start, invoice_id=X.
Payment P of amount A: Dr bank conv(A, rate(P)), payment_id=P.

For each invoice_refs item (X, a): Cr ar with invoice_id=X, payment_id=P, amount conv(paid_before+a, rate(X)) - conv(paid_before, rate(X)); paid_before = allocations to X by payments with an earlier moment.
Unallocated remainder u = A - sum(a): Cr advances conv(u, rate(P)).
FX difference D = bank - sum(ar credits) - advances: D>0 Cr fx_gain, D<0 Dr fx_loss.
Refund: payment with negative amount referring to a credit note.
Other expenses: Dr expense / Cr bank, no references.
A document's own posting is made 0-3 days after its local date and stays in the same interval (period or after-period window).
rounding_note: HALF_UP rounds halves away from zero; HALF_EVEN is banker's rounding

notes: ids, type and currency are compared as exact strings (case and spaces matter)
affected_ids must equal the canonical set exactly: the doc_ids named in issue_types (invoice_id / payment_id numbers are not canonical); order and repeats inside the list do not matter

evidence_ids: at least one complete evidence set is required; extra ids are allowed only if they exist (row_id, doc_id, invoice_id, payment_id or fx key 'YYYY-MM-DD:SRC:TGT'); an unknown evidence id makes the finding unmatched

claimed_amount_minor is a JSON integer in minor units of `currency`; a match needs |claimed - expected| <= amount_tolerance_minor[type] (0 for every type: amounts are exactly recomputable from the records with the rules above)
matching is one-to-one and maximum; a finding that matches no issue and every repeated finding is a false positive
structure errors (wrong JSON type, missing field, > 30 findings, > 10 evidence ids before de-duplication, explanation > 1000 characters) end the episode with reward -1
